verified_title: Self-Improving Interference Management Based on Deep Learning With Uncertainty Quantification
metadata_description: Abstract page for arXiv paper 2401.13206: Self-Improving Interference Management Based on Deep Learning With Uncertainty Quantification
method_summary: Deep ensembles predict means and variances. A wireless performance criterion determines whether the learned interference-management output is credible; uncertain outputs are refined using a conventional optimizer, and refinements feed subsequent training.
evidence_and_limits: Interference-management/sum-rate task. The accessed primary version is the open 2024 preprint, not a claim that a later paywalled journal version was reviewed. It directly rules out broad novelty for learned control plus uncertainty plus conventional fallback.
